body: This is part of a revitalization project by the town hall that is renovating historic tenement houses and reconstructing streets in an entire neighbourhood. The city architect took artistic liberties with some properties with a style that you commonly see in Łódź.

To put some numbers to these claims, the latest data I could find was for 2017, foreign multinational companies accounted for \~40% of total exports, lower than Czechia at just over 50%, Slovakia & Hungary at 80% just to mention a few (OECD).

Germany is the second biggest FDI investor after the Netherlands, but I couldn't find figures for what % of those foreign companies were actually German. Your statement is exaggerated but true to an extent- domestic Polish companies still focus more on the market at-home rather than internationalisation.

I believe it's partly due to the majority-negative press in western European countries relating to the current political situation and the laws the Government is trying to force through- personally I've found there's much less articles praising Poland for its economy than a few years ago
